text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah!
We were so close, too!
choice_data_list: Sorry, I couldn't win a single one...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it can't be helped. Even from the sidelines,
it looked pretty darn difficult!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Not being able to get it just means
today wasn't the day for it, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's get our revenge another day!
The "Voice of Destiny" says that's the best choice, too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: As long as we get it next time, that's all that matters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
